conflicts.description: Direct rule-exception conflict: §505(4) explicitly excludes the application of §§491a-496 for certain overdraft contracts, while §491a establishes mandatory pre-contractual information duties for all consumer credit contracts. For contracts under §505, the consumer may be denied critical pre-contractual information.

Circular dependency risk: §495(2)3 denies the right of withdrawal for contracts corresponding to §505. However, §505's own text (including the unofficial supplementary note) discusses complex default and notice scenarios. Applying §505 to deny withdrawal rights based on §495, while §505 itself may create ambiguous debtor obligations, could trap the consumer without a clear remedial path.
